events.description: Monica Geller says Rachel Green should currently feel great about Rachel Green's independence.
Monica Geller says Rachel Green is currently doing an amazing independence thing.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is currently questioning what is supposed to be so amazing about Rachel Green's situation.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green gave up everything.
Phoebe Buffay says Rachel Green is currently just like Jack from Jack and the Beanstalk.
Phoebe Buffay says Rachel Green should now see the point Phoebe Buffay is making.
Phoebe Buffay says Jack from Jack and the Beanstalk gave up something.
Phoebe Buffay says Jack from Jack and the Beanstalk got magic beans.
Phoebe Buffay says Jack from Jack and the Beanstalk woke up.
Phoebe Buffay says a giant beanstalk appeared outside Jack from Jack and the Beanstalk's window and was full of possibilities.
Phoebe Buffay says Jack from Jack and the Beanstalk lived in a village.
Phoebe Buffay says Rachel Green currently lives in the Village.
Rachel Green says Jack from Jack and the Beanstalk gave up a cow.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green gave up an orthodontist.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green knows that Rachel Green did not love the orthodontist Rachel Green gave up.
Phoebe Buffay says Jack from Jack and the Beanstalk loved the cow.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green's previous life with the orthodontist was a clear, figured-out plan.
Rachel Green says Monica Geller and Phoebe Buffay know what Rachel Green means.
Rachel Green says everything in Rachel Green's life is currently uncertain and floopy.
Monica Geller says Rachel Green is not the only one feeling uncertain.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay often do not know where they are going in life.
Monica Geller says Rachel Green should expect that at some point everything in Rachel Green's life will come together.
Monica Geller says everything in Rachel Green's life will become un-floopy in the future.
Phoebe Buffay says "un-floopy" is not a real word.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay does not like Rachel Green's question about what happens if everything does not come together.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Phoebe Buffay might not get magic beans in the future.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Phoebe Buffay might end up with only ordinary beans instead of magic beans.
